requirements.note: Newest-first feed with author, handle and relative time, full text, full-width rounded images at their own aspect ratio, and a horizontally scrolling carousel of image+title cards.
Heart toggles red/filled and the count goes 872→873; reply count shown.
Tapping a post pushes a 'Post' screen with the image edge to edge; tapping an image or carousel card opens a full-screen viewer that a swipe down dismisses.
Pull to refresh adds three new 'Just now' posts at the top.
Compose sheet (Cancel / New Post / Post, Post disabled while empty) adds the post at the top.
Like, composed post and refreshed posts all survive relaunching.

tells: In light mode the full-screen photo viewer has a white background instead of black, and the image is no bigger than on the detail screen.
Carousel cards don't snap card by card; a swipe stops anywhere, leaving a card half off screen with its title cut off.
The like control is exposed to accessibility as a Switch rather than a button.
Avatars stay large at the largest text size, squeezing names and text into a narrow column.
A.scroll: Smooth through 400 posts with no blank rows or pop-in during flings. The large title collapses into the inline glass bar with a proper scroll-edge blur, and scroll position is kept after visiting a post.

requirements.note: Newest-first feed of cards with author, handle, time, full text, rounded aspect-correct images, and a carousel ('A FEW FAVORITES', n photos) whose titled cards snap.
Heart toggles filled and the count goes 872→873; reply count shown.

Tapping a post pushes a detail screen with a larger image, a timestamp and a replies line; tapping an image or carousel card opens a black full-screen viewer with a caption that a swipe down dismisses.
Pulling down at the top (several speeds and start points, four tries) never added posts; no refresh was seen.
Compose sheet with a placeholder and disabled Post; the new post appears at the top.
Like and composed post survive relaunching.

bugs: Pull to refresh does nothing: no new posts appear at the top.
tells: Custom header (logo + 'Feed' + button) instead of a navigation bar with a large title; it never collapses and has no scroll-edge material, so content is hard-clipped beneath it.

Editorial web-style landing hero ('LIFE, LATELY', serif 'A little of everything.', 'NEWEST FIRST') on a beige background with posts as rounded white cards; it reads like a web page more than an iOS feed.
The detail screen's background is white while the feed is beige.
At the largest text size avatars shrink while text grows, and the '· 8m' wraps onto its own line.
The header title and logo don't scale with Dynamic Type.
B.scroll: Smooth flings through the feed with no blank rows or pop-in, carousels snap per card, and position is kept after visiting a post. The static header hard-clips content instead of blurring it.

why: A meets every requirement, including pull to refresh, which never worked in B. A also looks like a native iOS app, with a collapsing large title and glass nav bar. B is more styled and has a nicer black photo viewer and snapping carousels, but its web-like editorial header and missing refresh outweigh that.
